name: product-discovery
title: Product discovery and management
summary: Decide what to build and why: customer interviews, problem validation, jobs-to-be-done, MVP scoping, specs, prioritization and roadmaps, and the feedback loops that tell you whether it worked.
useWhen: Is this idea worth building? How do I validate it?
Help me plan and run customer interviews
Turn these interview notes into what to build
Scope the MVP; what can I cut?
Write a spec or PRD for this feature
Prioritize this backlog or these feature requests
Build a roadmap for the next quarter
Do we have product-market fit? Should we pivot?
A customer keeps asking for a feature; should I build it?

notFor.topic: Event tracking, funnels, retention analysis and A/B tests
Wireframes, flows, usability tests and interface copy
Engineering estimates, technical planning and build-versus-buy
